policy.evidence_authentic_only: Final asset must be a real, provenance-controlled photograph or microscopy image. No generative replacement or undisclosed composite.
policy.field_process_authentic: Final asset must document a real field/process condition or an honestly staged real procedure using real equipment/material.
policy.controlled_real_capture: May be photographed as a controlled still-life/setup by the project or sourced/licensed, but remains a real photograph.
policy.rights_rule: Technical suitability and publication rights are tracked separately. A technically excellent image is not approved until commercial print/digital rights are verified.
policy.diagnostic_rule: Where a diagnosis is named, provenance/technical confirmation must support that diagnosis; visual appearance alone is not treated as definitive when the chapter requires laboratory/inspector confirmation.
